summary: Backend-only regression test of the WhatsApp numero_telefone fix. All 5 target checks pass: login OK, GET /api/whatsapp/conexoes returns instance user_fabf3ca4_f2bfdb96 with status='conectado' and numero_telefone='5527999507920', GET /api/whatsapp/conexoes/{id}/status returns 'conectado' and does NOT overwrite the numero_telefone (still '5527999507920' after the call), GET /api/whatsapp/status-servico and /api/whatsapp/config/evolution both return 200. No message-sending endpoints were called.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/whatsapp/conexoes returns paginated envelope {items,total} — good. Ensure the frontend consumer handles this shape (not a bare list).
obter_numero_conectado() extracts digits from ownerJid via /instance/fetchInstances — consider caching or throttling since it now runs on every status poll to avoid rate-limiting from Evolution API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_whatsapp_numero.py covers login + conexoes list + status persistence regression. /api/whatsapp/conexoes returns paginated {items,total}. Expected instance user_fabf3ca4_f2bfdb96 with number 5527999507920. Never call /api/whatsapp/mensagens/enviar or enviar-cobranca/confirmacao endpoints — they send real messages.
rca of the issue: Original bug: /instance/connectionState only returns state (open/closed), not the phone number, so numero_telefone stayed null. Fix: obter_numero_conectado() calls /instance/fetchInstances and parses ownerJid (digits only). Called from GET /conexoes/{id}/status and verificar_status_conexao when status=='conectado'. Verified: numero_telefone persists as '5527999507920' after a status refresh (no regression).
